name: Keidanren Nature Conservation Fund (KNCF) Grant Program
summary: Annual grants from Japan's business federation fund for NGOs running biodiversity conservation, related social and capacity-building projects in developing countries, mainly in the Asia-Pacific, or in Japan, from small first-time grants to three-year collaboration grants.

geography.label: Developing countries mainly in the Asia-Pacific region, or Japan

amount.note: Collaboration grants, for projects run jointly by several NGOs

reporting: Grantees submit an interim report and a final report through the KNCF online system on fixed dates; Collaboration Grant holders report in person each year instead of an interim report.

eligibility.rule: Can report activities, budgets and granted-project finances when KNCF requests
Has incorporated status or equivalent societal credibility as a voluntary organisation
Has conducted nature conservation projects for at least 3 years
Has appropriate cooperation from authorities, related organisations, NGOs and residents at project locations
Project results do not benefit any organisation or individual
Uses scientific experts or obtains their advice and cooperation to implement the project
No permanent-staff labour costs or full outsourcing; partial outsourcing is capped at 10% of the total grant amount

documents: Financial statements or certified audits for the past 3 years (not Basic A or Basic B)
Documents proving corporate status, for incorporated organisations (not Basic A or Basic B)

status.quote: Please submit your application within the application period listed below.

administered_by.quote: Please make any inquiries regarding Guidelines, Application and reports to the trustee, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Ltd.

applicant_types.quote: It has incorporated status or is a voluntary organization with societal credibility equivalent to an incorporated organization.

geography.quote: Region: Activities that are based in developing countries mainly in the Asia-Pacific region or inside Japan.

access.quote: Organizations that wish to receive grants under the Keidanren Nature Conservation Fund (KNCF) Grant Program are asked to confirm the application details below and submit the "Application Documents" following the listed application procedures.

amount.quote: Large-size grant with an upper annual limit of 20 million Yen with the requirement that applying projects are collaborative projects involving multiple non-governmental organizations.

reporting.quote: Organizations that have received grants must submit an "Interim Report" by October 31st, 2027, 17:00 (Strictly adhere to the deadline).

eligibility.quote: (1) It can appropriately report its activities, budgets and financial status of granted projects, when requested by KNCF.
(2) It has incorporated status or is a voluntary organization with societal credibility equivalent to an incorporated organization.
(3) It has a record of conducting nature conservation projects for 3 years or more

(1) Appropriate cooperation has been obtained from the government organizations, related international organizations, non-governmental organizations and residents in the locations of the target projects.
(2) The results do not benefit any organization or individual.
(3) The project is implemented by experts with scientific knowledge, or the advice and cooperation of experts with scientific knowledge has been obtained in implementing the project.

(1) Personnel costs (labor costs for permanent staff) (2) Outsourcing costs (outsourcing of all project work to a third party) Moreover, even in the case of partial outsourcing, no more than 10% of the total grant amount may be applied to the outsourcing costs.

after_award.quote: Organizations that have received grants must submit an "Interim Report" by October 31st, 2027, 17:00 (Strictly adhere to the deadline).
Organizations that have received grants must submit a "Final Report" by April 30th, 2028, 17:00, JST (Strictly adhere to the deadline).
